lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife! You're listening to Radio Tenerify, and it is a beautiful Wednesday out there.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is — clear skies, 21 degrees down in the south. Classic Tenerife, honestly. Perfect beach weather.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Now, we do want to briefly mention — a story that did make the rounds back in late May — a British man sadly lost his life following an incident in the Las Verónicas area of Playa de las Américas. A sobering reminder to look out for each other on a night out.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Stay safe out there, everyone. But on a brighter note — Santa Cruz has a big weekend lined up!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Yes! This Saturday it's the Urban Beach Festival at the Puerto de Santa Cruz — Colombian sensation Beéle brings his Borondo Tour to the island. That's one to catch.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: And then Sunday, Kapo plays the Palmetum car park for his very first Tenerife show. Two great nights in a row!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Clear skies, warm evenings, live music — not a bad week to be on the island.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Not at all. Take care of yourselves, enjoy every moment, and we'll see you back here soon on Radio Tenerify!
